name: ENOXAPARIN SODIUM 40MG/0.4ML PREFILLED SYRINGE INJECTABLE SOLUTION 2 PIECES
description: Enoxaparin sodium is an anticoagulant indicated for the prevention and treatment of thromboembolic disorders. It is commonly presented in two-piece, 40 mg/0.4 ml prefilled syringes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
